english.title: Fail to control / place an item brought upon the Midland Metro so as not to cause obstruction / inconvenience / danger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having brought an item, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM..), onto

(A)_[a vehicle on]_
(B)_[part of]_

the Midland Metro Light Rapid transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to control or place it so as to avoid obstruction, unnecessary inconvenience or danger to a person or damage to property
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(2) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
